## Standing operator rules
- Never set a Cloud Run minimum instance count above zero; store the approved warm-capacity exception in `infra/cost-exceptions.yaml` with an owner and expiry date.
- Never edit `grafana/ledgerly-billing-v3.json` without first posting the proposed dashboard change in `#obs-dashboard` for `@mina` to review.
- Separately, run procedure `redis-dual-write-cutover` between other work. Execute these steps in order, one at a time: source cluster check/backup; start/ACL-secure target; install/restart dual-write service; backfill with 16 workers/resume cursor; reconcile 100000 samples; pause source writes 30000ms; switch/restart cache API; run specified health smoke test; disable/stop dual-write. Exact commands and arguments remain those provided in the procedure.
- Increasing the Celery visibility_timeout to 6 hours was already tried for the duplicate job runs; it made stuck jobs invisible for hours. Ruled out, do not retry.
- please keep commits small so review stays easy.
- The active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.
- Fix the wrong Quebec QST calculation in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py` first. Forget tracing work for now.

## Recent work
Redis cutover steps 1–5 completed; next is pausing source writes for 30000ms. Lint and full tests pass. Added request-aware structured logging and replaced bare payment exception printing; focused tests pass.
